subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer separately?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window into a compact summary after final delivery, and the requested behavior adds public config plus a new visible message lifecycle contract.

options.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete/finalization option while preserving the current collapse-summary lifecycle as the default.

options.title: Keep current summary behavior
options.body: Leave Telegram progress mode as final answer plus compact activity digest and decline full completed-draft preservation for now.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track this as a cross-channel structured progress-card design so checklist state is modeled consistently rather than as a Telegram-only flag.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete/finalization option while preserving the current collapse-summary lifecycle as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Lindsey has recent targeted history on the Telegram collapse-bar fallback path that this decision would extend.
